column1: # The applications' and libkeiland's allowed OS operations (check.sh A1-A5, ws188-p003; Guardrail "app と設定",
# "Bluetooth と Display も compositor 経由（2026-10-08 ユーザー）").  An application reaches the system only through
# libkeiland's kl_system_* (the compositor and libkeiland-backend do the OS's part); these are its own functions.
# Columns, separated by tabs: the check, a source (a file, or a directory ending in /), the name found (a function, a
# socket word, a literal, an included header; * for any), and why it is allowed (the decision).
# A1 literal of /dev /proc /sys /run /var /etc, a .sock or a daemon's name  A2 a local socket  A3 the account and
# group databases, the file systems' sizes and mounts, sysctl  A4 starting a process  A5 an OS or daemon header.
# T1 a thread of the system (pthread, C11 threads) in place of libkeiland's  N1 a socket or a wait of the system in
